units.source_text: 名人一直下到白144，轮到黑145封盘。

en.t: The Master kept playing through White 144, and then it was Black 145's turn to be sealed.

units.source_text: 大竹七段抓起棋子，刚要放下，又落入沉思。

en.t: Otake 7-dan picked up a stone and was just about to set it down, but then sank back into deep thought.

units.source_text: 这时刻，已到中途暂停时间，七段走出廊道封盘。

en.t: By then it was already time for the mid-game adjournment, and the 7-dan went out into the corridor to seal his move.

units.source_text: 名人寂寥地环视了棋盘一圈，一动也不动。

en.t: The Master gazed around the board with a lonely air and did not move at all.

units.source_text: 他的下眼睑微微发热，有些许浮肿。

en.t: His lower eyelids felt faintly hot and were slightly swollen.

units.source_text: 在伊东对局时，名人一个劲儿看钟点。

en.t: During the match in Ito, the Master kept looking at the clock.
